$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天機獨坐子午，《深造講義》p.94。

rules.text: 陽剛的天機，適合開創性的時期，不宜守成。
rules.en: A firm Tian Ji suits times of building something new, not of holding steady.

source.quote: 阳刚的天机宜行开创性的运限或流年，不宜守成

rules.text: 陰柔的天機，適合利於守成的時期；遇到多變化的時候，反而動輒得咎。
rules.en: A soft Tian Ji suits times for holding steady; in times of much change, every move tends to backfire.

rules.text: 對宮的巨門化忌，你常因不滿環境、是非口舌而見異思遷，但換了環境，際遇仍多不佳。
rules.en: Ju Men opposite you is transformed by Ji: dissatisfaction, gossip and friction often make you want to move on, yet after the change things still don't go well.

source.quote: 而见异思迁，但转变环境之后，仍多际遇不佳

rules.text: 對宮的巨門吉化，你愈變化，愈多良好的際遇，能為事業作出好計劃。
rules.en: Ju Men opposite you has a favourable transformation: the more you change, the better your chances, and you can plan well for your career.

rules.text: 會照的天同化忌，令你內心常有困擾、缺乏安全感，謀私利的心也較重。
rules.en: Tian Tong transformed by Ji in your four directions leaves you often troubled inside and short of security, with a stronger pull towards self-interest.
